end_to_end_success.inclusion_semantics: Successful measured requests only; warmup and all failures excluded.

itl.denominator: adjacent distinct per-token observations from successful measured requests
itl.inclusion_semantics: Unavailable when one SSE event contains multiple fixture tokens.

observed_token_span_per_interval.denominator: successful measured requests with at least two exact output tokens
observed_token_span_per_interval.inclusion_semantics: Last observed token event minus first observed token event, divided by token intervals; this metric is not TPOT.

timing_disclaimer: These measurements are loopback fixture measurements used to verify the benchmark harness and measurement semantics. They are not LLM-serving, model, runtime, GPU, or production-performance measurements.

tpot.denominator: successful measured requests with at least two exact output tokens
tpot.inclusion_semantics: Terminal success minus first output token, divided by exact output tokens minus one.

ttft.denominator: successful measured requests with first output token
ttft.inclusion_semantics: Dispatch to first parsed fixture output-token event.
